what: For research-heavy factual questions (who uses X tool in production, current state of Y landscape, feasibility of Z approach), delegate to the Agent tool with a thorough structured prompt UPFRONT instead of running piecemeal WebSearch calls across multiple turns. This session: I ran 4-5 piecemeal WebSearches about yao-pkg adoption across several turns and concluded "no flagship users." Then when the user pushed me to verify harder, I spawned an Agent with a 12-point research prompt — it found AWS Amplify, Firebase CLI, Kong Insomnia, Balena Etcher, DataDog CI, Automattic Studio, Stoplight CLIs, and ~15 others in a single pass. Piecemeal search didn't surface them because I wasn't using GitHub code search (`"@yao-pkg/pkg" in:file filename:package.json`) which the Agent did. Rule: when the question is "verify X in the real world" and the answer could swing the decision, first action is Agent tool with a structured multi-target prompt, not WebSearch.
why: Complement to memory 149 (do research upfront).
